verdict.rationale: Highnote's docs homepage advertises a GraphQL API with an "interactive code explorer", which directly points to an explorable API surface. A test environment that mirrors production would let examples run safely. But this rests on a single marketing line, with no description of a browsable reference, runnable request examples, or how the explorer works. The 404 OpenAPI probe is not a contradiction, since the API is GraphQL. Missing for 10: documentation of the explorer's features (schema browsing, in-browser execution against the test environment), evidence of runnable examples attached to reference entries, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
